name: Maybe
description:
Maybe is a personal finance management application designed to help you track your expenses, income, and investments in one place. With an intuitive interface and powerful features, Maybe makes it easy to understand your financial situation and make informed decisions about your money.

**Key Features:**
- **Expense Tracking**: Easily log and categorize your expenses
- **Income Management**: Track multiple income sources
- **Investment Monitoring**: Keep an eye on your investments and their performance
- **Budget Planning**: Create and maintain budgets to control your spending
- **Financial Reports**: Generate detailed reports to understand your financial habits
- **AI-Powered Insights**: Get personalized financial advice using AI technology

**Use Cases:**
- Personal budget management
- Expense tracking and categorization
- Investment portfolio monitoring
- Financial goal setting and tracking
- Cash flow analysis

**Learn More:**
- [Maybe GitHub Repository](https://github.com/maybe-finance/maybe)

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Postgres password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Secret key base
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
services:
  maybe-web:
    container_name: maybe-web
    image: ghcr.io/maybe-finance/maybe:latest
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/app/storage
        target: /rails/storage
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: maybe_user
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: maybe_production
      SECRET_KEY_BASE: ${SECRET_SECRET_KEY_BASE}
      SELF_HOSTED: "true"
      RAILS_FORCE_SSL: "false"
      RAILS_ASSUME_SSL: "false"
      DB_HOST: maybe-db
      DB_PORT: 5432
      REDIS_URL: redis://maybe-redis:6379/1
      OPENAI_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${OPENAI_ACCESS_TOKEN}
    depends_on:
      maybe-db:
        condition: service_healthy
      maybe-redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
      - maybe_net
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          memory: 1024M
  maybe-worker:
    container_name: maybe-worker
    image: ghcr.io/maybe-finance/maybe:latest
    command: ['bundle', 'exec', 'sidekiq']
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      maybe-redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: maybe_user
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: maybe_production
      SECRET_KEY_BASE: ${SECRET_SECRET_KEY_BASE}
      SELF_HOSTED: "true"
      RAILS_FORCE_SSL: "false"
      RAILS_ASSUME_SSL: "false"
      DB_HOST: maybe-db
      DB_PORT: 5432
      REDIS_URL: redis://maybe-redis:6379/1
      OPENAI_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${OPENAI_ACCESS_TOKEN}
    networks:
      - maybe_net
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          memory: 1024M
  maybe-db:
    container_name: maybe-db
    image: postgres:16
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/pgdata
        target: /var/lib/postgresql/data
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: maybe_user
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: maybe_production
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U maybe_user -d maybe_production"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    networks:
      - maybe_net
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          memory: 1024M
  maybe-redis:
    container_name: maybe-redis
    image: redis:8.2.1-alpine3.22
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/redis/data
        target: /data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    networks:
      - maybe_net
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          memory: 1024M
networks:
  maybe_net:
    driver: bridge
